name: showHeader
label: Show header
description: Select to display the insights panel header, including title

name: headerLabel
label: Header label
description: Label for the insights panel

name: headerSubLabel
label: Header sub label
description: Sub header for the insights panel, which would be shown below the header title

name: sourceId
label: Source
description: Name of the experience where insights panel is being used

name: dataSources
label: Data sources
description: List of KPI sys ids for which to display insights

name: customOrder
label: Insights custom order
description: List of insights category object which will define the ordering of insights in the panel

name: showTrend
label: Trend
description: Select to show insights into the trend of the indicator

name: showKpiSignals
label: KPI signals
description: Select to show signals regarding a business process that is behaving unexpectedly

name: showKeyContributors
label: Key contributors
description: Select to show which factors are contributing most to the indicator trend

name: showTarget
label: Target
description: Select to show that a target was hit or missed on its due date

name: showThreshold
label: Threshold
description: Select to show a threshold value that was passed

name: showPredictiveTarget
label: Predictive target
description: Select to show whether you are likely to reach your target by the due date

name: showPredictiveThreshold
label: Predictive threshold
description: Select to show whether the indicator is likely to pass the threshold value

name: showCustomInsights
label: Custom insights
description: Select to show the custom insights you have created

name: showProcessMining
label: Process mining
description: Select to insights related to process inefficiencies

name: poProjectIDs
label: Process mining project IDs
description: Select to insights related to process inefficiencies

name: periodStart
label: Period start date
description: Start date ('YYYYMMDD') from which the insights should be fetched

name: periodEnd
label: Period end date
description: End date ('YYYYMMDD') till which the insights should be fetched

name: showSeverity
label: Highlight insight cards by criticality
description: Select to insights related to process inefficiencies

name: showKpiSelector
label: Show KPI selector
description: Select to show KPI Selector dropdown in insights panel

name: showKpiNameOnCards
label: show KPI name on cards
description: Select to show KPI name on insights cards. When toggled off, insight's respective sub-category will be shown on the card

name: kpiLabelList
label: Custom KPI labels
description: List of objects specifying the KPI id and label for displaying in the KPI selector dropdown. If not specified, default KPI name will be shown

name: insightCardNavigationLabel
label: Label for insight card action
description: List of objects specifying the label for insight card navigation action based on category and sub_category
